Marketing.microprint: CIGUA · LEE TU ESTADO DE CUENTA · READS YOUR STATEMENT · RD$ · US$ · CUOTAS · QUINCENA ·
Marketing.heroBody: Cigua reads your bank's PDF, sorts every charge, tracks your cuotas, and tells you what's safe to spend until your next quincena.
Marketing.specimenLabel: Example with made-up data: a card statement turned into Cigua transactions.
Marketing.readTitle: Built for the Dominican bank statement.
Marketing.readBody: Every bank prints it its own way. Cigua reads it the way you would: line by line, without you typing a thing.
Marketing.col1Body: Works out date, description, and amount from the spacing between them, even when your bank doesn't label them.
Marketing.col2Body: Your name, email, and phone number are automatically removed from the text before the AI reads it.
Marketing.col3Body: Checks its sums against the statement's own totals. If they don't match, it tells you instead of inventing a number.
Marketing.pdfNote: Works with the PDF your bank sends you, including password-protected ones.
Marketing.quincenaTitle: What's safe to spend until payday.
Marketing.quincenaBody: Cigua takes what's in your accounts and subtracts what's already committed before you're next paid: card payments, cuotas, and subscriptions. You get one number.
Marketing.denominationLabel: Example: RD$ 12,480 available until payday on the 30th, with three payments due before then.
Marketing.cardsTitle: Your cards and cuotas, in RD$ and US$.
Marketing.cardsBody: Type your card's name and Cigua draws it the way it looks in your wallet. Every cuota knows how many are left.
Marketing.cardsTyped: Drawn from the typed name · example
Marketing.cuotaLeft: {n, plural, one {# cuota left} other {# cuotas left}}
Marketing.factCurrencies: One card, two currencies: the RD$ section and the US$ section each keep their own balance.
Marketing.factTax: Transfer tax and interbank fees are worked out for you, and the fee is waived between accounts at the same bank.
Marketing.closeTitle: Free to start. And your data stays yours.
Marketing.closeBody: Delete your account and everything in it whenever you like, from Settings.
Marketing.metaDescription: Cigua reads your bank statement, sorts every charge, tracks your cuotas, and tells you what's safe to spend until payday.
